item.title: Keeping Track of your Mistakes
item.description: TL;DR Start keeping track of your mistakes. “Mistakes”, here refer to what you’ve learnt but not what you’ve abandoned. Either add them to your existing blog or start blogging now. Or just Keep track of them in a dedicated git repository Or Use symlinks or git worktree to connect it to your project. My suggestion I recommend a docs/learnings directory in each of your projects gitignored and symlinked to the dedicated repo and hosting it as a blog for you to revisit.
